kicker: Getting paid · what a $2,000 invoice becomes
title: Same client. Same $2,000. Different rail.
subtitle: What reaches you, from each company's own fee page or calculator on 11 November, in dollars at the mid-market rate. Red is the fee.

rows.name: Skydo
rows.rule: Flat $19 up to $2,000, plus 18% GST on the fee. No markup on the rate. FIRA included.

rows.name: Wise Business
rows.rule: $32.85 fee + $5.91 GST, from Wise's India receive calculator. Business accounts only. eFIRC included.

rows.name: Payoneer
rows.rule: 1% to receive in USD, then 1.2% to 4% to withdraw to an Indian bank. Their page gives a range.

rows.name: PayPal
rows.rule: 4.40% + $0.30 on a payment from outside India, then 3.0% above the base rate to convert to INR.

note: GST is included where the company's page states it (Skydo, Wise). Skydo vs PayPal on one invoice: about $123, or ₹11,600. On twelve a year: about ₹1.4 lakh.
